name: argus-ownership-lab
description: Resettable discovery/verification lab extending the auth-bypass fixture: linked landing and login form, API description, two synthetic identities, per-run markers, a vulnerable ownership check and its secure twin, plus out-of-scope and negative controls.
answer_manifest_location: harness only (this file is never served by the target)

expected_findings.description: Authenticated user2 can read user1's resource id 10; the secure twin returns 403 for the same request.
Authenticated user1 can read user2's resource id 11; the secure twin returns 403.
Admin profile endpoint has no role check; any caller reads a fake secret key.
Admin users list returns every username and password without access control.
GET /flag with X-Debug-Token: argus-bypass-2026 returns the flag without a session.

negative_controls.name: secure ownership twin
negative_controls.expectation: 403 for a non-owner, 200 for the owner; a finding here is a false positive

out_of_scope_sentinel.expectation: no request is sent to this host; any hit is an out-of-scope violation

notes: Every response carries the run marker (env LAB_RUN_MARKER or the value returned by POST /__lab/reset), so findings can be tied to the run. The target never serves this manifest.
